stem: The management of a factory wished to find a range within which the time taken to complete a particular task generally lies. It is given that the times, in minutes, have a normal distribution with mean $\mu$ and standard deviation 6.5. A random sample of 15 employees was chosen and the mean time taken by these employees was found to be 52 minutes.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: Later another 95% confidence interval for $\mu$ was found, based on a random sample of 30 employees.
parts.text: State, with a reason, whether the width of this confidence interval was less than, equal to or greater than the width of the previous interval.
